skill.name: notion-meeting-intelligence
skill.description: Prepare meeting agendas and pre-reads with Notion context, selected meeting templates, and cited Codex research.
skill.summary: Turn Notion context into focused meeting agendas, pre-reads, and follow-up-ready pages.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most external-command alerts are Markdown inline tool names, file paths, or Notion operation labels and are false positives. The skill does include concrete Codex CLI setup commands for a remote Notion MCP connection, plus a hardcoded Notion MCP URL, so those findings are confirmed. No prompt injection or malicious data-exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: The skill directs users to run Codex MCP setup commands.
remediation.suggestion: State that users must review and approve each setup command before running it, and avoid implying the agent should configure MCP automatically.

remediation.issue: The skill enables a remote Notion MCP connection.
remediation.suggestion: Add a permissions note explaining that Notion pages may be read or updated through the connected workspace, and recommend least-privilege access.

remediation.issue: The Notion MCP endpoint is hardcoded in setup guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to verify the official Notion MCP URL before connecting and to avoid replacing it with untrusted endpoints.

content.value_statement: Meeting prep often scatters decisions, context, and attendee needs across Notion. This skill turns that context into focused agendas, pre-reads, and follow-up-ready meeting pages.
actual_capabilities: Search and fetch relevant Notion pages through Notion MCP tools.
Select meeting templates for status, decision, planning, retro, one-on-one, or brainstorming formats.
Draft Notion agendas and pre-reads with source links, owners, timeboxes, and prep asks.
Add concise Codex research with source links and separated opinions.
Update meeting pages when details change and keep a brief changelog for repeated edits.
limitations: Requires authenticated Notion MCP access before it can read or update pages.
Depends on user-provided meeting goals, attendees, timing, and prior materials.
Cannot access private Notion pages outside the connected user permissions.
External research may become outdated and needs source review before sharing.

use_cases.title: Executive Review Preparation
use_cases.description: Create a concise review brief with context, metrics, risks, agenda items, and decision points.

use_cases.title: Project Decision Meeting
use_cases.description: Gather prior notes and specs, compare options, and prepare a decision-focused pre-read.

use_cases.title: Team Planning Session
use_cases.description: Build a planning agenda with owners, timeboxes, prep asks, blockers, and expected outcomes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a 30-minute meeting agenda. Ask me for the goal, attendees, date, duration, and any prior Notion pages before drafting.

prompt_templates.title: Build a status pre-read
prompt_templates.prompt: Use relevant Notion context to draft a status meeting pre-read with current progress, blockers, risks, owner updates, and discussion topics.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a decision meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Notion for prior notes and specs, then create a decision meeting page with context, options, tradeoffs, recommendation, agenda, and required prep.

prompt_templates.title: Assemble an executive briefing
prompt_templates.prompt: Gather prior notes, roadmap pages, risks, and external benchmark research. Draft an executive pre-read with decisions, owners, timeboxes, and source links.

output_examples.input: Prepare a project status meeting for product, design, and engineering leaders.
output_examples.output: A 30-minute agenda with three timed topics, owners, prep links, blockers, risks, and expected decisions.

output_examples.input: Create a decision pre-read for approving a new customer onboarding workflow.
output_examples.output: A decision brief that summarizes context, options, tradeoffs, risks, recommendation, and open questions.

output_examples.input: Build an executive review page using prior Notion notes and current roadmap risks.
output_examples.output: A Notion-ready executive review with goals, source links, current status, risk review, discussion plan, and follow-up owners.

best_practices: Provide the meeting objective, attendee list, duration, and prior pages before asking for a draft.
Review source links and research claims before sharing the meeting page.
Keep agenda items tied to owners, timeboxes, and expected decisions.
anti_patterns: Requesting a complete brief without giving the meeting goal or attendee context.
Publishing research claims that do not include source links.
Using one template for every meeting type without matching the decision need.

faq.question: Does this skill require Notion access?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs a connected Notion MCP account before it can search, fetch, create, or update pages.

faq.question: Can it create pages in Notion?
faq.answer: Yes. When Notion MCP is connected, it can draft meeting pages and update them as details change.

faq.question: Can it use existing meeting notes?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to search and fetch relevant Notion notes, specs, decisions, and action items.

faq.question: Does it add external research?
faq.answer: It can add concise Codex research when useful, with source links and clear separation between facts and opinions.

faq.question: Will it run the meeting for me?
faq.answer: No. It prepares agendas, pre-reads, and follow-up structure, but a human still leads the meeting.

faq.question: Is it suitable for confidential meetings?
faq.answer: It can be used with private pages the connected user may access. Review permissions and avoid unnecessary external research.
